title: TensorFlow Model Predict
text: Predict responses using pretrained Python TensorFlow model, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough; {Path to model (SavedModel folder or Keras HDF5 file)} sets the name or path of Python TensorFlow model, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Inputs} sets the input port properties table, {Outputs} sets the output port properties table, {Path to Python file defining preprocess()} sets the name or path of Python preprocessing function file character and {Path to Python file defining postprocess()} sets the name or path of Python postprocessing function file character. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Path to model (SavedModel folder or Keras HDF5 file)
params.values: Name or path of Python TensorFlow model untitled (default) | character vector

params.name: Sample time (–1 for inherited)
params.values: Option to specify sample time –1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Path to Python file defining preprocess()
params.values: Name or path of Python preprocessing function file character vector

params.name: Path to Python file defining postprocess()
params.values: Name or path of Python postprocessing function file character vector
